Fossil Isle

Pinball
Your mission is always written big at the top, and a glowing arrow marks the shot.
Phone: tap the left or right half to flip. Right also fires the green side flipper by the launcher: flip it just as the ball flies past to jump up to the volcano crater, where everything scores triple.
Launch: drag down on the right half and let go. Further = stronger.
Keys: Z / ← left · M / → right · Space launch
